rationale: The deployment failed due to an ErrImagePull error, as the new image 'nginx:9.9.9-doesnotexist' does not exist. Rolling back to the previous working image 'nginx:1.27-alpine' will resolve this.

The deployment is failing to create new pods due to a missing 'app-secret' referenced by an environment variable, as indicated by recent changes and pod events ('Error: secret "app-secret" not found').
The container is consistently OOM-killed due to the recently reduced memory limit of 4Mi. Restoring the previous limit of 128Mi will allow the container to start successfully.
The readiness probe was changed to a non-existent path '/healthz-nonexistent', causing it to fail with a 404 and preventing new pods from becoming ready.
